title: Tahoe Summit Snowmobiling Tours
includes: Snowmobile for the duration of the tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: If you are looking for an exhilarating journey through the stunning backcountry of Lake Tahoe, the Summit Snowmobile Tour promises an unforgettable experience. Your adventure starts at the top of the trailhead in beautiful Hope Valley at an elevation of 7,200 ft. This guided, two-hour adventure is perfect for beginners and intermediate riders. You’ll experience breathtaking views, scenic vistas, and thrilling moments, with opportunities for pictures.
